summary: Robustness/performance audit of NeuroAxis: 30 findings, no product edits. Wrote docs/audit/v19/robustness.findings.json (30 findings, exactly the 12 required keys, enum-valid; 7 wrong / 9 suspect / 14 ok, 5 major / 25 minor) and docs/audit/v19/robustness.md (verdict×severity table, method, measured composition table, per-subsection evidence, direct answers to the brief's singled-out items, and the limits of what could be verified without Chrome). Everything was measured live, not retyped: ran verify:budget-report (exit 0), verify:area-toggles (exit 0, 472 assertions) and verify:pipeline (exit 0), and measured the shipped modules through the repo's own in-process TS loader plus the committed GLBs, the installed @react-three/fiber/three sources and the built dist bundle. Headline results: (1) the 'rendered triangles 599,204 <= 800,000' budget counts only the manifest — the 149 mounted procedural tubes add 214,560 tris, so the all-on scene draws 813,764 triangles, 13,764 (1.72%) OVER the cap the gate reports as PASS (rob-002); (2) TractTube's 'exactly ONE shared frame driver' is not implemented — the token is a per-instance useRef, so all 149 tubes dispatch the registry every frame (22,201 stepTractFrame calls/frame) and the documented fade lerp is applied 149x/frame (remaining fraction 5.5e-10 = a one-frame snap) (rob-001); (3) the 12 '#mirror' nerve contour parts are built, transferred (0.308 MiB) and sliced on every plane and then dropped because no canvas meta carries the '#mirror' slug, so the Plates live section and the PiP paint each paired cranial nerve on one side only while the 3D pass paints both (rob-003); (4) registrySentRef latches after the first registry send, so the anatomy loader's shipped retry can never reach the contour worker: after a recovery the canvas stops saying it is loading and paints without the recovered structures (rob-004); (5) D4 confirmed live — SectionCanvas appends only registryNerveParts(), so the 79 vessel registry parts (2.08 MiB) are ready and never sent (rob-021); (6) the brief's 77/40 counts no longer hold: measured 41 authored vessel courses / 79 registry parts / 103 both families / 41 vessel metas / 191 canvas metas vs the 40/77/101/190 still printed by README and by area-toggles' own closing summary, whose live assertions use the shipped tables and therefore pass (rob-006). Verified-and-held contracts: disposal (R3F never disposes prop-passed geometry/material — proved from the installed bundle, so the module caches are safe; per-instance materials all have matching disposes), WebGL context-loss overlay + PiP/SectionCanvas survival (untouched by the v16-v18 diffs), transferable ownership (fresh copies, 10.90 MiB built once per mount), worker coalescing (slice 3.6 ms mean / 6.9 ms worst vs the 66.7 ms 15 Hz budget), all six neuroaxis.* storage keys (validated, total reads), rapid Areas/Systems toggling, failed-mesh selection and missing origin3d (verified: no unit-sphere-at-origin class). Soft spots recorded: unclamped imaging window fields, the single-writer stale viewPreset key, the mount-once PiP imagery guard, no worker-restart affordance, an untested '?panelfail in dist' claim, an unbounded 60 Hz rAF hint poll, ~635 unmeasured drawables, and the silent All-off empty state. Browser-only claims (pixels, pointer, real context loss) were never made.
